history.note: First three rounds ran deterministic rules and Mock-only service tests; no live model request was issued. This ledger starts spend from zero.

price_adoption.ruling_source: Controller ruling supersedes the earlier 0.14/0.28 assumption; adopted rates are the official DeepSeek Flash rates below, worst-case peak.
price_adoption.key_availability: Controller reports the DeepSeek key is valid and reachable; this result is reused as precheck evidence. No repeated /models probe was issued by D.
price_adoption.peak_hours_utc: Mon-Fri 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00, excluding Chinese public holidays; all other hours off-peak. Any request crossing a peak/off-peak boundary is billed at peak.
price_adoption.current_band_at_precheck: 2026-11-17 08:2x UTC Tuesday -> peak; reserve uses peak prices.
price_adoption.superseded_assumption_note: The earlier 0.14 input / 0.28 output assumption is retired and must not be used for settlement.

worst_case_reserve.method: Before each request: reserve = (this request input estimate x peak input miss price) + (this request actual max_tokens x peak output price). After response, settle from real usage and release unused reserve. Peak prices are the worst case.
worst_case_reserve.output_token_budget_note: At 8192 max output tokens, the 60000 output cap allows at most 7 full-output requests; the output guard binds before the 30-request cap.
worst_case_reserve.stop_if_reserve_breaks: If settled cumulative + this request worst reserve would exceed 1.00 USD, 300000 input or 60000 output, do not start the request; stop at the current case and report. Do not shrink max_tokens or parameters to bypass.
